summary: Backend-only verification of the new HWG external admin console service token. All 11 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL. Verified: (1) ADMIN_API_TOKEN grants admin on /api/admin/me,/users,/dashboard,/metrics with synthetic principal user_id='svc_admin_console'; (2) bogus token AND missing Authorization header both -> 401; (3) rider session token (demo@roujaune.app) -> 403 with 'Admin access required' on /api/admin/me and /api/admin/users (authorization boundary intact); (4) interactive admin login regression: POST /api/admin/login (roger.parenzee@gmail.com/letmein9900) still returns a token and that token loads /api/admin/me as a non-service admin principal; (5) rider regression: rider token still works on /api/auth/me and /api/analysis/streak (200). No admin data was mutated (read-only GETs only).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:_resolve_token — service-token branch uses secrets.compare_digest with the raw string, which raises TypeError on non-ASCII tokens. Current ADMIN_API_TOKEN is base64url so it's safe, but consider comparing bytes (.encode()) to harden against future token rotations.

auth.py:_resolve_token — the service-token check runs on every request BEFORE the DB session lookup. That's the right ordering for perf but means any request that happens to carry a token equal to ADMIN_API_TOKEN gets full admin. Recommend documenting rotation policy and, ideally, restricting to a subnet or per-origin allow-list at the gateway.

auth.py — service principal is minted per-request (not persisted). No admin_sessions row exists for it; this is fine but means /api/admin/logout will silently no-op for the console. Consider returning a 204 explicitly for the console UX contract.
seed_data_creation: None. All calls were read-only GETs; only login POSTs (rider + admin interactive) created short-lived session tokens per existing seeded credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter86 covers the HWG service-token backend contract. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_admin_service_token.py for regression. If ADMIN_API_TOKEN is rotated, update the constant at the top of that file (or better, source it from /app/backend/.env). Public preview URL exposed via frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
